title: AI Agent Reasoning Ledger Foundation
goal: Create the additive persistence and schema foundation for AI reasoning and proposal audit records.
scope: Add disabled-by-default, additive AgentReasoning and AgentProposal data structures, migrations, schemas, and read-safe service helpers that can store AI observations, hypotheses, proposals, context snapshots, provider metadata, confidence, and review status without dispatching any new runtime work.
generation_reason: AI_PENTESTING_AGENT.md calls for auditable AgentReasoning and AgentProposal records before any reasoning loop can be safely activated.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Ledger only. Do not run LLM calls, dispatch proposals, auto-approve actions, or change worker runtime behavior.

success_criteria: AgentReasoning and AgentProposal records are additive and linked to existing run/task context where appropriate.
Stored context snapshots and proposal outputs are auditable without mutating original evidence.
Provider metadata and failure states are representable without requiring a live provider.
Tests cover creation, retrieval, and immutability of evidence/source records.
Docs define the ledger as inactive until later reasoning/proposal tasks are promoted.
must_not_touch: pack registry, validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: Reasoning/proposal records are additive and auditable.
No AI provider call or proposal dispatch runs in this slice.
Canonical evidence and finding fields remain unchanged.

before_promotion: AI Pentesting Agent source alignment is completed and logged.
The ledger field set is reviewed against existing evidence/provenance models.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with reasoning-ledger changes and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the inactive AI reasoning ledger baseline.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.
